name: Vim
summary: AI use is allowed for research, small targeted fixes, and help writing tests, but contributors must disclose AI use with an Assisted-by trailer, understand and be able to explain every line, and ensure licensing. Large mostly generated pull requests, AI-generated commit messages and PR descriptions, pasted AI answers to reviewers, and AI-written reviews of others' pull requests are not acceptable.

evidence.quote: Use of AI is allowed within the limits mentioned below, but you remain fully responsible for everything you submit. Disclosure of AI use is required, using an `Assisted-by:` trailer.
Research, looking things up, understanding existing code.
Small, targeted fixes (e.g. for security issues).
You must understand every line of your change and be able to explain it.
You must have the right to submit the code under the Vim license.
Help with writing tests and benchmarks.
Large pull requests that were mostly generated.
Generated commit messages or PR descriptions.
Write them yourself that ensures you have a good understanding of the change.
Answering review questions by pasting AI output.
Posting AI-generated reviews on other people's pull requests. Automated CI checks are fine.
Fixing spelling, grammar and translations is fine.
You are expected to fix problems your change introduces.
Maintainers decide whether a contribution is acceptable.
